adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, createAllCalendarEvents was changed to iterate over an array of destination calendars and do `const createdEvent = await createEvent(...)` inside a `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` loop. This is verifiably sequential (no `Promise.all` for those per-destination calls), so end-to-end latency will grow roughly linearly with the number of destinations/hosts on collective events. The claim about “no timeout”/“hung API blocks indefinitely” is plausible but not directly verifiable from this diff alone (timeouts may be handled inside individual calendar service implementations), so it’s better framed as a performance/robustness concern introduced by the new multi-destination behavior rather than a definite functional bug.
